dynamic.zh: 有活力的、充滿幹勁的；不斷變化的

ex.en: She is a dynamic young leader.
ex.zh: 她是一位充滿活力的年輕領導者。

ex.en: We work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
ex.zh: 我們在快節奏、變化多端的環境中工作。

dynamic.en: full of energy and new ideas, or always changing

dynamic.zh: （人與人之間的）互動關係、動態

ex.en: The team dynamic changed after he joined.
ex.zh: 他加入之後，團隊的互動關係就變了。

ex.en: Family dynamics can be complicated.
ex.zh: 家庭成員之間的關係可能很複雜。

dynamic.en: the way people in a group affect each other

ex.en: It's become a hassle to keep on dyeing my hair.
ex.zh: 一直染頭髮變得好麻煩。

ex.en: My boyfriend wants to dye his hair purple.
ex.zh: 我男朋友想把頭髮染成紫色。

ex.en: The cloth was dyed bright red.
ex.zh: 這塊布被染成了鮮紅色。

dye.en: to change the color of something using a colored liquid

ex.en: This dye is made from natural plants.
ex.zh: 這種染料是用天然植物做的。

ex.en: She bought a box of hair dye.
ex.zh: 她買了一盒染髮劑。

dye.en: a substance used to change the color of cloth or hair

ex.en: The first lute was invented during the Qin dynasty.
ex.zh: 最早的琵琶是在秦朝發明的。

ex.en: In this tomb from the Han dynasty, a book was found.
ex.zh: 在這座漢朝古墓中發現了一本書。

ex.en: In the Ming Dynasty (early 15th century) the centre of Beijing was the Forbidden City.
ex.zh: 明朝（十五世紀初）時，北京的中心是紫禁城。

dynasty.en: a series of rulers from the same family

ex.en: The class studies the dynamics of moving objects.
ex.zh: 這堂課研究移動物體的動力學。

ex.en: Group dynamics can change when a new member joins.
ex.zh: 新成員加入時，團體的互動關係可能會改變。

ex.en: The dying man asked to see his family.
ex.zh: 那位垂死的男子要求見他的家人。

ex.en: Small shops are a dying business in this town.
ex.zh: 小商店在這個鎮上是日漸沒落的行業。

ex.en: We sat by the dying fire and talked.
ex.zh: 我們坐在快熄滅的火堆旁聊天。

ex.en: The dying light of the sun turned the sky red.
ex.zh: 夕陽將盡的餘暉把天空染成了紅色。

ex.en: Doctors found a dysfunction in his thyroid.
ex.zh: 醫生發現他的甲狀腺功能失調。

ex.en: The family therapist spoke about dysfunction in the household.
ex.zh: 家庭治療師談到家中運作失常的問題。

ex.en: They grew up in a dysfunctional family.
ex.zh: 他們在失和的家庭中長大。

ex.en: The dysfunctional printer jammed again.
ex.zh: 那台故障的印表機又卡紙了。

ex.en: A dysfunctional team wastes time arguing.
ex.zh: 運作失常的團隊會把時間浪費在爭吵上。

ex.en: Workers used dynamite to clear the rocks for the new road.
ex.zh: 工人用炸藥炸開岩石來開闢新路。

ex.en: The old mine was full of unused dynamite.
ex.zh: 那座舊礦坑裡有許多沒用過的炸藥。

ex.en: They dynamited the old bridge to make way for a new one.
ex.zh: 他們炸毀了舊橋，為新橋讓路。

ex.en: The team dynamited the rock wall to open a tunnel.
ex.zh: 工程隊炸開岩壁以開鑿隧道。

ex.en: The dyke protects the low farmland from the sea.
ex.zh: 這道堤防保護低窪的農地不被海水淹沒。

ex.en: Workers repaired the dyke after the heavy rain.
ex.zh: 大雨之後，工人修補了堤防。

ex.en: The two families were joined by a dynastic marriage.
ex.zh: 兩個家族因一場王朝聯姻而結合。

ex.en: Historians study the dynastic changes in ancient China.
ex.zh: 歷史學家研究中國古代的王朝更替。

ex.en: The dyer colored the cloth a deep blue.
ex.zh: 染匠把布染成深藍色。

ex.en: A village dyer worked beside the river.
ex.zh: 村裡的一位染工在河邊工作。

ex.en: The young manager brought new dynamism to the team.
ex.zh: 這位年輕的經理為團隊帶來了新的活力。

ex.en: The city is famous for its economic dynamism.
ex.zh: 這座城市以經濟活力著稱。

ex.en: She has long dyed hair, bright red in color.
ex.zh: 她留著一頭染成亮紅色的長髮。

ex.en: The shop sells hand-dyed wool in many colors.
ex.zh: 這家店販售多種顏色的手染羊毛。

ex.en: The bicycle light is powered by a small dynamo.
ex.zh: 這輛腳踏車的燈由一個小型發電機供電。

ex.en: A dynamo turns movement into electricity.
ex.zh: 發電機把動能轉換成電力。

ex.en: Our new manager is a real dynamo who never stops working.
ex.zh: 我們的新經理是個精力旺盛、永不停歇的人。

ex.en: She is a dynamo on the basketball court.
ex.zh: 她在籃球場上是個活力十足的球員。

ex.en: Her son has dyslexia, so reading is hard for him.
ex.zh: 她的兒子有閱讀障礙，所以閱讀對他很吃力。

ex.en: Teachers use special methods to help students with dyslexia.
ex.zh: 老師用特殊的方法幫助有閱讀障礙的學生。
